questions.question: Cobras set a database record (List A) with a value of 156. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Wins', held by Cobras.

questions.question: At which ground did Liesel Jordaan record their career-best innings (147*, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Heat on 2006/01/14.

questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 4 wickets in a match double more times, Mieke van Voorst or Suné Luus?
questions.explanation: Mieke van Voorst: 1 times. Suné Luus: 2 times.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2019 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2019.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Eastern Storm or Lions?
Who holds the record for 'Most Matches as Captain' (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 119.
